scope: Cross-chat review of EAIC, SDK, gateway, media and retained physical results. This audit sends no motion, creates no booking, and performs no gateway or robot activation.
reviewed_chats: Add Master arm motions to EAIC
Fix EAIC heart and head shake

checks.request: Account View opens the selected successful submission
checks.evidence: Live Chrome: older review agentech-20261105204320-q6kvo7 loads six commands including return_to_home; newer review agentech-20261105220323-4sc9uc loads its five commands. Legacy redirect preserves the ID.

Full npm test: 350 Node tests and 103 Python tests; explicit Master gateway suite: 90 Python and 78 Node tests; typecheck and production build pass. Worktree audit requires MASTER_SDK_ROOT and MASTER_SDK_PYTHON to select the actual SDK checkout.

checks.request: All three robots use separate gateways
checks.evidence: Actual dispatch function smoke test routes Master to trusted-master-runner.py, Navi to trusted-navi-runner.py, and Aegis to trusted-robot-runner.py. Exactly one booking bridge process observed. No cross-model restart or installation performed.

checks.request: Explicit bilateral raw hand-guide entry before adjustments
checks.evidence: Missing entry, adjustment before entry and adjustment after restore are rejected; the explicit entry sequence passes. Native presets do not require this raw entry.

checks.request: All Master supported functions connected; Movement A optional
checks.evidence: 53 distinct scheduled methods exactly match the execution allowlist. Includes bilateral arms, waist, Movement A/B, restore, head, golf and 16 native presets. Software support is distinct from current native readiness.
SDK ledger records 16 standing preset methods / 25 variants on November 4. EAIC #104 Heart completed. Complete visual coverage of all 25 was not retained.

checks.request: Head turn/shake successful with honest EAIC results
checks.evidence: #102 result-name mismatch was repaired and replayed with measured endpoints. #104 completed Heart but stopped during shake cycle two. be8aa80 fixes feedback-receipt timing and retains incomplete evidence; newest code not activated or physically rerun.
Defaults verified in shoulder, elbow and wrist SDK constants. Native waist, absolute poses, saved presets and restore retain separate timing contracts.

checks.request: All upper-body timing and full restore improved
checks.evidence: Finite connection reuse and retained neutral support cover shoulders, elbows and wrists and full restore. Latest full restore hardware benchmark remains 22.938 seconds on the earlier version; no new all-joint timing claim.

checks.request: Preserve all raw adjustments on upgraded Master firmware
checks.evidence: Other chat's captured v1.0.10 runtime lacks initialized manipulation subscriber and runner. Native MC was not stopped. Compatibility files are staged; live entry and all upper-body adjustments are not yet restored on this firmware.

Clean SDK main full Master suite reproduced 19 failures. Seventeen fixture cases repaired and published, preserving 67 assertion/raises nodes. Two oscillation cases remain; prior independent probe found a related stopping-follower domain escape rejected by its guard.

checks.request: Navi five-command program through EAIC; no home or Camo
checks.evidence: #103 recorded 5/5 completed: stand, forward, frontflip, sideflip left, turn. Inter-command gaps 3-13 ms. Turn measured -44.141419 degrees for requested -45; forward distance was not measured.
#103 cleanup made three bounded attempts; connection timed out during initial battery read before stop/damping. Earlier five-command completion remains completed. No final post-expiry pose claim.

checks.request: Persistent saved home across Navi reboot
checks.evidence: Saved home is retained. Automatic boot-yaw recovery needs accepted one-time procedure qualification for the current robot/cell/calibration. No current boot-binding or qualification sidecar observed. Not a daily recalibration requirement.

Streams observed in #103 and #104. Persisted OBS configuration: 1280x720, 30 fps, NVENC H264, CBR 3500 kbps, one-second keyframe, p3, ultra-low-latency tuning, no lookahead/B-frames/multipass. This is not a glass-to-glass latency measurement.

Website production is READY at fc98818. PC SDK still selects c91dac9. The installed gateway is intact but differs from main in five Master preparation/execution files, after line-ending normalization. Other chat explicitly ended with local-only work after power-off.

checks.request: Future tests both arms then waist then combined, default speed and full restore
checks.evidence: Twelve programs retained in the October 28 test pack. Each explicitly enters bilateral guidance and finishes with full restore. Custom speed and effort remain separate pending EAIC physical tests.

checks.request: Clean local computer and push relevant work
checks.evidence: Previous turn removed 959.5 MiB of ignored caches and recycled its isolated test checkout. Both publication checkouts preserve unrelated working-tree changes in other locations. This audit publishes only reviewed fixture repairs, a stale bow-support message correction and audit evidence.
